blocks.title: Time complexity
blocks.text: Time complexity measures how the runtime of an algorithm increases as the size of the input grows.
Sorting a few numbers is quick, but as the volume of numbers increases so does the time; time complexity lets us predict how the runtime grows as the list gets larger.
